invariants.rationale: The method likely requires a non-null instantTime to schedule a compaction operation, as it is passed to other components.
context must be non-null to perform work using the engine context, as it is passed to an executor.
extraMetadata is passed to the compaction executor and should not be null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
A non-empty instantTime is likely required, as empty strings would not make sense for a time identifier in compaction scheduling.
instantTime should not be only whitespace, so it is trimmed and checked for non-empty content.
